title: Isotopes
summary: Same element, different mass: isotopes, carbon dating, and radioactive isotopes used in medicine and energy.

ib.note: Extension: relative atomic mass calculations follow in MYP 4

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 8: Journey Inside the Atom (isotopes and isobars)

objectives: I can define isotopes and identify them from atomic and mass numbers.
I can explain why isotopes of an element have the same chemical properties.
I can describe uses of isotopes in medicine, archaeology and energy.
misconceptions: All isotopes are radioactive and dangerous.
Isotopes have different numbers of protons.
